text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (October 7, 2024) for 2655 Lawrence Avenue East.

The Property Standards Committee - Scarborough Panel: 1. Deferred the appeal of the Property Standards Order (October 7, 2024) for 2655 Lawrence Avenue East, Folder Number 24 220924 PRS 00 IV to its meeting on December 12, 2025 in order to give the Appellant time to obtain a demolition permit, and to allow the City time to conduct a reinspection of the property.
